violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: food contact surfaces sanitized with chlorine sanitizer solution 0ppm.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CDI: CFM added chlorine to solution until concentration reached 150ppm per manufacturer instructions.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: plastic squeeze bottles: oil, water, sauces and bulk bin of cornmeal.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS instructed CFM to place common food name on food items when removed from original container.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Boxes of food stored on the floor inside the walk in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS instructed CFM to relocate boxes of food to shelves inside the walk in freezer. TACO SSAM (Inspection Date: 08/25/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: scoop handle directly touching tortilla chips in metal pan on prepcounter and scoop directly touching shredded mozzarella cheese in Usta 4 DWR refrigerator in the front kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI: CFM removed scoop out of container of tortilla chips and shredded mozzarella cheese.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at the bar handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: pork 118F, steak 132F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC REHEATED FOOD TO 165F

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: observed raw shell eggs stored at ambient temperature on the cook line for 1 hr.
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. PIC PLACED EGGS IN THE REFRIGERATOR AND AGREED TO KEEP THEM THERE.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: undercooked egg on the happy hour and special menus served with no disclosure statement
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. PIC WILL ADD DISCLOSURE STATEMENT TO THE MENU.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name.OBSERVED UNLABELED SPRAY BOTTLE OF CLEANER.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. TACO SSAM (Inspection Date: 09/04/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the bar being used to store equipment
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. TACO SSAM (Inspection Date: 04/11/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Approved Record Keeping, Tags/Labels
violations.observation: A record keeping system is not in place to maintain the tags of used/sold shellstock in chronological order correlated to the date that is recorded on the tag/label.
violations.corrective_action: Tags/labels must be maintained in chronological order by the date recorded on the tag/label when the last shellstock is used/sold. EHS SPOKE TO OWNER WHO AGREED TO BUY PRE COOKED CLAMS OR FOLLOW THE CORRECT RECORD KEEPING PROCEDURES FOR SHELLSTOCK TAGS.

violations.title: Shellstock Removed from Tagged or Labeled Container
violations.observation: Shellstock has been removed from the tagged/labeled container without preserving source identification. OBSERVED FRESH CLAMS PORTIONED FOR SEAFOOD SOUP WITH NO SHELLSTOCK TAGS.
violations.corrective_action: Shellstock that has been removed from the tagged/labeled container must have a system used to identify source. EMPLOYEES DISPOSED OF CLAMS

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: tongs used for flipping meat on the grill
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE WASH RINSE AND SANITIZE TONGS.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: birria 130F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC REHEATED THE BIRRIA TO 174F

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: salsa 45F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED SALSA.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: carnitas in the walk in cooler made on 3/27
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED CARNITAS.
